title: Brice W NDE 4906
content: I observed the body surrounded by a surgical team, then the hospital from above, then the hospital surrounded by wintering cornfields. I felt relief that the physical ordeal was over, colored with some minor apprehension about family. I quickly lost all sight of my earthly environment. In space, it was not cold or particularly dark or foreign, but somehow familiar and vaguely pleasing. I came upon or was approached by familiar beings. They tried to talk with me, but I hesitated to connect with them. Instead, I was continuing to reflect on the life left behind. I was feeling anger and resentment about the medical malpractice leading to my ruined body. I heard assurances that I could return to a body that would be made serviceable. But I reacted negatively, because I didn't want to return to that situation. I was lovingly advised that this was my choice, which mollified me somewhat. I was then taken more deeply into light, thinking I was getting my wish and being taken home. A life review of sorts followed, though the physical life just left made up only the smallest part of it. I seemed to be recalling (remembering) myself as a being prior to that physical incarnation, a being of the same character as those now with me. The recall was vivid. I had no doubt at the time of its accuracy. It was like rousing from a dream. The restored memory included awareness that the choice to return to physicality, though rightly mine, had been already made prior. I 'saw' that I had previously known of and been in agreement with the plan to exit the body as just occurred, for the purpose of rousing transcendent awareness that would gradually unfold upon return. I 'saw' that most of the current vision would fade upon return, but slowly return, in order that I could do what I had gone there to do. This vision of things of itself seemed to draw me back toward Earth. Some part of me resisted, still wanting to stay, not wanting to return to the old situation with memory once again dimmed. It seemed such feeling had no effect on the transition, however. I was told not to fret, so to speak, that guidance would come to me in increasingly recognizable form, from that point on, and that I would at length become aware as I was then, even while 'in' the body. (It was actually clear then, as it is now, that we aren't really 'in' bodies - they are perhaps more like stiff mittens covering and restraining a tiny portion of ourselves).

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Quickly lost all sight of earthly environment; found himself 'in space'.

arrival.other_being_detail: Described as 'familiar beings' of the same character as those with him prior to physical incarnation.

environment.environment_other_detail: In 'space' that was not cold or particularly dark or foreign; somehow familiar and vaguely pleasing.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Exit/transition was 'for the purpose of rousing transcendent awareness that would gradually unfold upon return'; guidance would come in increasingly recognizable form; would become aware as he was then even while in the body.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Anger/resentment about medical malpractice; assurances about returning to a serviceable body; recalled pre-incarnation identity and prior agreement/plan; guidance promised after return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with expanding vantage (body → hospital → surrounding fields), then loss of earthly sight into 'space', then encounter with familiar beings and communication about returning, then being taken into light, then a life review emphasizing pre-incarnation memory, then return drawn by the vision despite resistance.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Life review emphasized pre-incarnation memory far more than the just-ended physical life; explicit sense that the choice to return had already been made prior and that most of the vision would fade then slowly return; metaphor that bodies are 'like stiff mittens covering and restraining a tiny portion of ourselves'.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I observed the body surrounded by a surgical team, then the hospital from above, then the hospital surrounded by wintering cornfields." "In space, it was not cold or particularly dark or foreign, but somehow familiar and vaguely pleasing." "I was lovingly advised that this was my choice" "It was like rousing from a dream." "(It was actually clear then, as it is now, that we aren't really 'in' bodies - they are perhaps more like stiff mittens covering and restraining a tiny portion of ourselves)."
